No protocol requestId/version/hash/cursor/CSRF fields, fabricated success/online states, team/AI/ToDoo features or OS/browser-dialog chrome. Secret data empty or masked only. One coherent selected condition; hidden alternatives remain hidden. Preserve header/close/body-scroll/footer actions and actual disabled guards; do not derive new disabled rules from API constraints.

Current source baseline has NO revisions and Git unavailable, so do NOT invent version list, difference/raw tabs, restore button, older-version loader, Git tab or diff controls merely to satisfy generic all-state summary.
